rows.reason: recurrent_state: 24 of 32 layers are Gated DeltaNet linear-attention layers with per-request recurrent and 3-token convolution state that vLLM-owned KV blocks cannot rebuild at start_pos; a scheduler cache hit would resume the 8 full-attention layers from cached KV and the 24 recurrent layers from zero state. Server is launched with --no-enable-prefix-caching.

rows.reason: Scheduler-driven chunking stays off, so max_num_batched_tokens is raised to max_model_len and every prompt up to 262144 tokens is submitted in one prefill_forward call; the model chunks internally at 2048 tokens and accepts any start_pos for preemption resume.

rows.reason: The served default recipe stays on the device sampler; requests that need the host sampler (min_p, bad_words, logit_bias, allowed_token_ids, min_tokens, structured outputs, top_logprobs>0 and, on one chip, logprobs) are rejected at admission with HTTP 400. The canonical sampling suite runs against a server with the compatibility mode on; its metrics are labeled separately.

Device sampled-token logprobs are implemented for the TP4 vocabulary-sharded geometry only (tt/sampled_logprobs.py). On the one-chip p150 profile a logprobs request routes to the host sampler in compatibility mode or is rejected at admission; see doc/vllm_integration/README.md.
